name: Darius G-class freighter
description: The Darius G-class freighter was a type of freighter manufactured by Darius. Commonly used throughout the galaxy. The freighter saw use during the Imperial Era by civilians and criminal factions, including its Mining Guild Freighter derivative. The Darius G-class was still in service during the Cold War and subsequent First Order-Resistance War, taking part in First Order operations as well as being part of the Citizens' Fleet that fought against the Sith Eternal's forces.
